281503.name: Kur'Ush Mallet
281503.where: Shop components + an existing Xan weapon
281503.notes: Shop components + an existing Xan weapon. Modified Xan Weapons are made from a finished 'X of the Xan' weapon plus one shop-bought component. No tradeskill skill is required; the component must be QL 150 or higher and is consumed. Gluttony of the Xan + Notum Enriched Nano Paste - 16x Layer = Bhan'Zor Hammer Abandonment of the Xan + Notum Enriched Nano Paste - 16x Layer = Kur'Ush Mallet Lust of the Xan + Nano Pylon = Peh'Wer Pistol Peh'Wer Pistol + Runtime Critical Area Analyzer = Troa'Ler Pistol Envy of the Xan + Rapid-Reload-And-Fire Gyro = Rhat'Ata Gun  (MG/SMG - not usable by every profession) Angst of the Xan + Low-Light Targeting Scope = Gan'Kar Rifle  (Rifle - not usable by every profession) NOTE: The client data corroborates the chain: the description text on Peh'Wer Pistol reads 'The Lust of the Xan has been tweaked to a higher performance.'

265019.name: Ofab Viper Mk 6
265019.where: Battlestation - Ofab terminals, Unicorn Defence Hub
265019.notes: Battlestation - Ofab terminals, Unicorn Defence Hub. Bought as Mk 1 with Victory Points at the Ofab weapon terminals in the Unicorn Defence Hub (the 'Ofab Shop') in the Battle Station central area. VP is earned on Battlestations and on Lost Eden (Alien Mothership) missions. Terminals are bracketed by level: 10-30, 31-60, 61-100, 101-150, 151-200, 201-214, 215-220. Upgraded Mk 1 -> Mk 6 (five upgrades, strictly sequential) by adding a Kyr'Ozch Bio-Material clump to the weapon. No tradeskill skill is required; the clump must be at least 80% of the weapon's QL. Each upgrade also changes the weapon's appearance. Bio-Material by weapon: Type 34 for Ofab Panther (1h Blunt) and Ofab Bear (2h Blunt); Type 18 for Ofab Mongoose (1h Edged), Ofab Wolf (2h Edged) and Ofab Viper (Piercing); Type 812 for Ofab Peregrine (Pistol), Ofab Hawk (SMG) and Ofab Tiger (Bow); Type 687 for Ofab Cobra (Rifle), Ofab Shark (Assault Rifle) and Ofab Silverback (Shotgun). The clumps drop from the bosses in Lost Eden Alien Mothership missions (taken from the Unicorn Recruiter at the Unicorn Outpost in the Outerzones, via ICC) and from the Dreadloch bosses at the Clan and Omni camps. No VP price list is published; the only figure found is a player report of 1100 VP for a QL75 Ofab Pistol. NOTE: ao-universe lists Type 812 as covering Bow; wiki.aodb.us lists it as Crossbow. Unresolved - both recorded in _unverified.

280725.name: Greed of the Xan
280725.where: Legacy of the Xan team instances (device) + Pandemonium (base weapon)
280725.notes: Legacy of the Xan team instances (device) + Pandemonium (base weapon). Xan Weapon Upgrade Device + <base weapon QL 299/300> = <X> of the Xan. No tradeskill skill required. The Xan Weapon Upgrade Device is QL 300, NODROP/Unique and is consumed by the combine. It drops in the three Legacy of the Xan team instances entered from floor portals in the Central Hub playfield: The Alien Threat / 'Mitaar Hero' (portal at 350 x 410, boss Technomaster Sinuh), LoX: Ground Chief Vortexx (portal at 523 x 307), and The Xan 12-man (portal at 419 x 324, final boss Deranged Xan). Since patch 18.3 none of them need the old prerequisite quests. No drop rate is published. The combine itself needs NO tradeskill skill. Base weapon for most sins is the matching Lord/Lady of <sin> from The Beast in Pandemonium. Dawn of the Xan and Dusk of the Xan take Sword of Dawn / Sword of Dusk instead (see those entries). Angst of the Xan additionally accepts High Lord of Angst; Anger/Envy/Angst of the Xan additionally accept the matching Superior Rebuilt Perennium weapon.

246244.name: Sword of Dawn
246244.notes: Pandemonium (Shadowlands). Notum Seed + Sunrise Hilt = Sword of Dawn  (Clan/Redeemed side) Novictum Seed + Sunset Hilt = Sword of Dusk  (Omni/Unredeemed side) Requires 500 Weapon Smithing - the only step in the whole Xan line with a real skill requirement. Notum Seed drops from The Night Heart on the Redeemed (Clan) side of Pandemonium; Novictum Seed from The Night Heart on the Unredeemed (Omni) side. Neither is a 100% drop; both also turn up in player shops. Sunrise Hilt (Clan) and Sunset Hilt (Omni) are 100% NODROP drops from The Beast. Recorded rates over 104 kills: Sunrise 18.27%, Sunset 4.81%. Neutrals capped at 25,000 faction cannot obtain these. NOTE: Feeds Dawn of the Xan / Dusk of the Xan.
